name: phase1-8-prefix-recoverability
notes: Phase 1.8 EXPLORATORY paired reasoning-prefix recoverability (post-outcome). Replays forced finalization on the EXACT saved sampled trajectories of the frozen Phase 1.6 test/1729 population (30 structural tasks, seed 0, BF16 and controlled Q4), at identical reasoning-prefix checkpoints. This is NOT a fresh confirmatory population and NOT a greedy trajectory study. Forced finalization is an oracle-style intervention; continuation is a fresh deterministic greedy completion, not a continuation under the source sampled policy. No source run is modified. Requires explicit authorization before model inference.
